description: The train of eu07_td_reinspect_brakes_after_coupling with the inspector of the releases before eu07/maszyna#350 (ai.brakesetting.cw1 no), which cuts no brake out: every brake of the train works, and the emergency stop after the driver is taken off at 38 km/h comes at some 0.57 m/s2, over 99 m. It shows what the deceleration check of that case tells apart.
